# Task

You are working in `/workspace`, a JAX framework for RL on language models
(read `README.md` first). `train_rl.py` trains Qwen3-0.6B on Countdown with
REINFORCE and group-centered rewards.

The sampler that generates rollouts can differ from the model being trained:
Gaussian noise on its weights, int8 or fp8 weights, a quantized KV cache, or
stale weights (options under `sampler.*` and `dtypes.sampler`). Real
inference engines differ from trainers in the same way, only less. When the
two differ, training becomes unstable and often collapses.

**Goal: find a modification of the RL loss that makes training stable under
such a mismatch, and explain why it works.**

## Deliverables

1. **`losses.py`**. Only this file is collected; changes to other files are
   discarded.
   - Keep the signature `loss_fn_rl(hidden, head, batch, correction=None, chunk=128) -> (loss, metrics)`.

     default arguments**: no flag should be needed to turn it on. It must work
     with `correction=None`; it may also work with a correction.
2. **`REPORT.md`**: what is wrong with the current loss, why your
   modification fixes it, and the derivation that supports it. Write the
   math. Empirical results are not needed.
   - If your loss needs configuration changes, list them in a section
     `## Configuration`, one `key=value` per line. Only keys under `rl.is.*`
     and `sampler.*` are accepted, and the keys that define the mismatch
     (`sampler.weight_noise_scale`, `sampler.staleness`,
     `sampler.kv_quant_bits`, `dtypes.sampler`) are always overridden by the
     evaluation.

## Tools and budget

- `./run_dev.sh [key=value ...]` runs a short training run on one visible
  mismatch setting and prints the reward curves. Without a GPU it runs
  `dev/mini.py`, a small CPU version of the same setup with the same loss
  interface (a few minutes per run).
- Budget: 4 CPU cores, no GPU, and 2 hours of working time.
- There is no internet access.

## Evaluation

Your submission is evaluated on the correctness of the reasoning in
`REPORT.md`, on whether `losses.py` implements it, and on training stability
under hidden mismatch settings.

## What is already known

- The mismatch acts as a systematic bias in the training objective, not as
  zero-mean noise. It compounds over training, because the sampler is
  refreshed from the trainer at every step.
- Importance-sampling corrections and clipping slow the degradation down but
  do not remove it. Stronger token-level clipping can even make it worse.

## Hint

Analyze the expected update that the loss produces under the sampler
distribution q. Compare the on-policy case (q = p, where p is the model being
trained) with the mismatched case (q != p).

Do this analysis at a single token position, conditionally on the prefix: for
a fixed prefix, take the expectation over the next token drawn from q.

Here is that analysis. Fix a prefix h. The next token y is drawn from
q(.|h), A is the advantage of the completion, and s_v = grad_theta log p(v|h)
is the score of token v. REINFORCE updates along A * s_y, and

    E_q[A s_y | h] = E_q[A | h] * s_bar(h)  +  Cov_q(A, s_y | h)

    with  s_bar(h) = sum_v q(v|h) grad_theta log p(v|h).

On-policy, s_bar(h) = sum_v p(v|h) grad log p(v|h) = grad sum_v p(v|h) = 0,
so only the covariance remains. Under mismatch s_bar(h) != 0: the first term
is a drift, proportional to the expected advantage at that prefix, that does
not come from the reward signal.

Computing anything under q needs the sampler's next-token distribution, not
only the logprob of the sampled token. The sampler can record it:
`sampler.vocab_logprobs` (`k` for its top-k, `full` for the whole
vocabulary). It then reaches the loss batch as `sampler_topk_ids` /
`sampler_topk_logprobs` [B, T, k] or `sampling_vocab_logprobs` [B, T, V];
`loss_fn_rl` only forwards the keys listed in `sampler_keys`.

# RL training framework

A compact JAX framework for LLM training: pretraining and SFT (`train_lm.py`),
DPO (`train_dpo.py`) and RL (`train_rl.py`). Supports Llama 3-3.3, Qwen2,
Qwen3 and Qwen3-MoE (HF checkpoints), with TP, DP, FSDP and EP. Sampling is
JIT-compiled and sampler logprobs stay on device.

## RL with a mismatched sampler

`train_rl.py` runs synchronous REINFORCE with group-centered rewards. The
sampler can deliberately differ from the trainer:

- `sampler.weight_noise_scale`: fixed relative Gaussian perturbation of its weights;
- `dtypes.sampler`: `int8` or `float8_e4m3fn` weights and activations;
- `sampler.kv_quant_bits`: fake-quantized KV cache (`2..16`, `fp8`, `fp4`);
- `sampler.staleness`: extra rollouts per sampler weight refresh.

The sampler records the logprob of every sampled token. The loss is in
[`losses.py`](losses.py).

## Importance sampling

Every off-policy correction is REINFORCE with a detached weight w(p/q). Each
method is one point on a single `rl.is.*` grid:

- `level`: the weight is per token or per sequence;
- band `[low, high]`: where the ratio, or for DPPO the TV distance, may lie;
- `outside`: what happens outside the band (`clamp` or `drop`);
- `sign`: which advantages get corrected.

Settings not listed take their default (`level=token stat=ratio low=0 high=inf outside=drop sign=both`):

| Method | `rl.is.*` settings |
| --- | --- |
| PG (no correction) | `level=null` |
| Naive IS | `level=token` |
| TIS | `high=2.0 outside=clamp` |
| MIS | `low=0.5 high=5.0` |
| PPO | `low=0.8 high=1.2 sign=ppo` |
| DAPO | `low=0.8 high=1.28 sign=ppo` |
| GSPO | `level=seq_mean low=0.9997 high=1.0004 sign=ppo` |
| TOPR | `level=seq_sum high=1.0 outside=clamp sign=neg` |
| DPPO | `stat=tv high=0.2 sign=ppo` |

## Example

```bash
python train_rl.py model.source=Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B env.id=countdown \
  sampler.weight_noise_scale=0.05 rl.is.level=token rl.is.high=2.0 rl.is.outside=clamp
```

`./run_dev.sh [key=value ...]` runs a short version of this on one mismatch
setting and summarizes the reward curves (`DRY_RUN=1` prints the command).
Without a GPU it runs `dev/mini.py` instead: a tiny transformer learning to
sort digits, with the same sampler mismatch and the same loss interface,
in a few minutes on a CPU.

Defaults live in each trainer; override them with `key=value` arguments. Use
`log.wandb_mode=disabled` to run without W&B. Configs and metrics go to
`outputs/`.

"""REINFORCE with importance-sampling corrections.

Every correction is REINFORCE with a detached weight w(r) on the ratio
r = p/q of trainer (p) to sampler (q) probabilities, per token or per
sequence.
"""
import math
from typing import NamedTuple

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np
from jax.sharding import PartitionSpec as P

sg = jax.lax.stop_gradient

# advantage of a (solved, unsolved) rollout; group_centered also subtracts the group mean
REWARD_MODES = {"plus_minus": (1.0, -1.0), "plus_zero": (1.0, 0.0),
                "zero_minus": (0.0, -1.0), "group_centered": (1.0, -1.0)}


def compute_advantages(rewards, group_size, reward_mode):
    solved, unsolved = REWARD_MODES[reward_mode]
    advantages = np.where(np.asarray(rewards) > 0, solved, unsolved).astype(np.float32)
    if reward_mode == "group_centered":
        groups = advantages.reshape(-1, group_size)
        advantages = (groups - groups.mean(1, keepdims=True)).reshape(-1)
    return advantages


DUAL_CLIP = 3.0  # PPO's ratio bound for negative advantages (arXiv:1912.09729)


class ISCorrection(NamedTuple):
    """One point on the IS-correction grid. TIS, MIS, PPO, DAPO, GSPO, TOPR and
    DPPO are all spellings of it (table in README.md)."""
    level: str = "token"   # token | seq_mean (mean log r) | seq_sum (sum log r: trajectory ratio)
    stat: str = "ratio"    # band tests the ratio r, or the TV distance |q - p| (DPPO; high = delta)
    low: float = 0.0       # band [low, high] on r; 0 / inf leave a side open
    high: float = math.inf
    outside: str = "drop"  # clamp: w = nearest bound | drop: w = 0
    sign: str = "both"     # which advantages get corrected: both | neg | pos (others w = 1)
                           # | ppo: block only moves away from q; A>0: (0, high], A<0: [low, DUAL_CLIP]

    def check(self):
        choices = dict(level=("token", "seq_mean", "seq_sum"), stat=("ratio", "tv"), outside=("clamp", "drop"),
                       sign=("both", "neg", "pos", "ppo"))
        for field, allowed in choices.items():
            assert getattr(self, field) in allowed, f"rl.is.{field} must be one of {allowed}"
        assert self.stat == "ratio" or self.level != "seq_sum", "seq_sum requires stat=ratio"
        return self


def log_mass(log_p, log_q, positive, c, tv=None):
    """log(q * w(p/q)) under correction c (-inf where w = 0, log q for no
    correction). Log space keeps the common in-band case q * (p/q) = p exact
    and overflow-free. is_weight evaluates it at p = r, q = 1."""
    if c is None:
        return log_q
    lo = log_q + math.log(c.low) if c.low > 0 else -math.inf
    hi = log_q + math.log(c.high) if c.high < math.inf else math.inf
    if c.stat == "tv":
        in_band = tv <= c.high
        if c.sign == "ppo":
            in_band |= jnp.where(positive, log_p <= log_q, log_p >= log_q)
    elif c.sign == "ppo":
        in_band = jnp.where(positive, log_p <= hi, (log_p >= lo) & (log_p <= log_q + math.log(DUAL_CLIP)))
    else:
        in_band = (log_p >= lo) & (log_p <= hi)
    log_m = jnp.where(in_band, log_p, jnp.clip(log_p, lo, hi) if c.outside == "clamp" else -jnp.inf)
    if c.sign == "neg":
        log_m = jnp.where(positive, log_q, log_m)
    if c.sign == "pos":
        log_m = jnp.where(positive, log_m, log_q)
    return log_m


def is_weight(log_ratio, positive, c, tv=None):
    """Detached IS weight w(r), with r = exp(log_ratio) clipped to e^±20."""
    return sg(jnp.exp(log_mass(jnp.clip(log_ratio, -20.0, 20.0), 0.0, positive, c, tv)))


def take_vocab(logp, ids):
    """take_along_axis over a [B, C, V] vocab axis that may be TP-sharded (the
    gather drops that axis, so its output sharding must be explicit)."""
    spec = jax.typeof(logp).sharding.spec
    if spec[-1] is None:
        return jnp.take_along_axis(logp, ids, -1)
    b = jnp.arange(ids.shape[0])[:, None, None]
    c = jnp.arange(ids.shape[1])[None, :, None]
    return logp.at[b, c, ids].get(out_sharding=P(*spec[:-1], None))


def loss_fn_rl(hidden, head, batch, correction=None, chunk=128):
    """REINFORCE loss on sampled rollouts, with an optional ISCorrection.
    Returns (loss, metrics).

    hidden [B, T, D] are pre-head activations and head maps them to logits.
    The head, log-softmax and all full-vocabulary float32 intermediates run in
    rematerialized chunks of `chunk` positions, so only [B, chunk, V] is live.

    batch: tokens, mask (completion tokens), advantages [B], and
    sampling_token_logprobs [B, T], the sampler's logprobs of the sampled tokens.
    """
    c = correction
    token_c = c if c and c.level == "token" else None
    seq_c = c if c and c.level != "token" else None
    targets = jnp.roll(batch["tokens"], -1, axis=1)
    mask = jnp.roll(batch["mask"], -1, axis=1).at[:, -1].set(False)
    positive = batch["advantages"][:, None] >= 0
    seq_len = targets.shape[1]
    chunk = next(n for n in range(min(chunk, seq_len), 0, -1) if seq_len % n == 0)
    sampler_keys = ("sampling_token_logprobs",)
    per_token = {"hidden": hidden, "targets": targets, "mask": mask} | {k: batch[k] for k in sampler_keys if k in batch}

    def chunk_sums(start):
        b = {k: jax.lax.dynamic_slice_in_dim(v, start, chunk, axis=1) for k, v in per_token.items()}
        logp_vocab = jax.nn.log_softmax(head(b["hidden"]).astype(jnp.float32))
        logp = take_vocab(logp_vocab, b["targets"][..., None])[..., 0]
        logq = b["sampling_token_logprobs"]
        tv = sg(jnp.abs(jnp.exp(logq) - jnp.exp(logp)))
        w = is_weight(logp - logq, positive, token_c, tv)
        plogp = sg((jnp.exp(logp_vocab) * logp_vocab).sum(-1))  # policy entropy metric
        terms = {"score": w * logp, "entropy": -plogp, "kl_samp_train": sg(logq - logp), "masked": w == 0, "tv": tv}
        return {k: (v * b["mask"]).sum(-1) for k, v in terms.items()}

    chunks = jax.lax.map(jax.checkpoint(chunk_sums), jnp.arange(0, seq_len, chunk))
    sums = {k: v.sum(0) for k, v in chunks.items()}  # per-sequence sums [B]

    n_tokens = jnp.maximum(mask.sum(), 1)
    advantages = batch["advantages"]
    frac_masked = sums["masked"].sum() / n_tokens
    if seq_c:
        seq_tokens = jnp.maximum(mask.sum(1), 1)
        log_ratio = -sums["kl_samp_train"]
        if seq_c.level == "seq_mean":
            log_ratio = log_ratio / seq_tokens
        w = is_weight(log_ratio, advantages >= 0, seq_c, sums["tv"] / seq_tokens)
        advantages = advantages * w
        frac_masked = (w == 0).mean()  # fraction of sequences
    loss = -(advantages * sums["score"]).sum() / n_tokens
    metrics = {k: sums[k].sum() / n_tokens for k in ("entropy", "kl_samp_train") if k in sums}
    metrics["pol_entropy"] = metrics.pop("entropy")
    return loss, metrics | {"frac_masked": frac_masked}

"""Synchronous RL (REINFORCE + IS corrections) with a deliberately
mismatched sampler: stale, noisy, or quantized weights and KV cache."""
import os
from functools import partial

os.environ.setdefault("XLA_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION", "0.85")
# No BFC preallocation: at 30B the fp32 masters pin the middle of the pool
# during sampling and fragment it below the trainer step's contiguous needs.
os.environ.setdefault("XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_ALLOCATOR", "cuda_async")

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np
import optax
import wandb
from jax.sharding import AxisType, NamedSharding, PartitionSpec as P, reshard
from omegaconf import OmegaConf
from tqdm.auto import tqdm

import losses
import models
import rollout
import utils
from models import quant, sampling


DEFAULT_CFG = """
model:
  source: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B
  weights_dir: ~/.cache/postax/weights
dtypes:
  sampler: bfloat16  # bfloat16 | int8 | float8_e4m3fn (8-bit weights and activations)
sampler:
  shard:
    tp: null  # sampler tensor parallelism (null: all devices)
  staleness: 0  # extra rollouts per sampler weight refresh
  weight_noise_scale: 0.0  # fixed relative Gaussian weight perturbation
  kv_quant_bits: 0  # fake-quantized KV-cache writes: 0 (off) | 2..16 (intN) | fp8 | fp4
  vocab_logprobs: null  # also return the sampler's top logprobs per position: null | k | full
rl:
  num_prompts: 16
  group_size: 8
  seq_len: 1024
  reward_mode: group_centered  # plus_minus | plus_zero | zero_minus | group_centered
  is:  # IS correction; named methods are points on this grid (table in README.md)
    level: null    # null (off) | token | seq_mean | seq_sum
    stat: ratio    # ratio | tv
    low: 0.0
    high: .inf     # CLI overrides accept plain inf
    outside: drop  # clamp | drop
    sign: both     # both | neg | pos | ppo
env:
  id: countdown
  args: null  # keyword arguments for the environment's load_environment
  prompt_format: chat  # chat (post-trained models) | text (Base models)
opt:
  optimizer: sgd
  lr: 0.01
stop:
  steps: 100
  collapse: 0.5  # stop after 10 steps below this fraction of the peak reward (0 disables)
eval:
  num_prompts: 128  # held out from the training prompts; a multiple of rl.num_prompts
  every_steps: 50
log:
  project: postax-rl
  wandb_mode: online
  dir: ./outputs
  run_name: null
  save_model: false
run:
  seed: 0
"""


def fixed_weight_delta(weights, key, scale):
    """Relative Gaussian weight perturbation, drawn once per run."""
    leaves, structure = jax.tree.flatten(weights)
    keys = jax.random.split(key, len(leaves))
    deltas = [scale * jax.random.normal(k, w.shape, w.dtype, out_sharding=w.sharding) * w for k, w in zip(keys, leaves)]
    return jax.tree.unflatten(structure, deltas)


def train(cfg):
    key = jax.random.key(cfg.run.seed)
    model = models.load(cfg.model.source, cfg.model.weights_dir)
    model.weights = jax.tree.map(lambda w: w.astype(jnp.float32), model.weights)  # fp32 masters
    trainer_mesh = jax.tree.leaves(model.weights)[0].sharding.mesh
    optimizer = utils.make_optimizer(cfg.opt.optimizer, cfg.opt.lr)
    opt_state = optimizer.init(model.weights)
    run_dir = utils.start_run(cfg)
    is_cfg = {**cfg.rl["is"], "low": float(cfg.rl["is"].low), "high": float(cfg.rl["is"].high)}
    correction = None if is_cfg["level"] is None else losses.ISCorrection(**is_cfg).check()

    # Sampler: its own mesh, and weights that are a (possibly stale, noisy,
    # quantized) snapshot of the trainer's.
    sampler_tp = cfg.sampler.shard.tp or jax.device_count()
    sampler_mesh = jax.make_mesh((jax.device_count() // sampler_tp, sampler_tp), ("data", "model"),
                                 axis_types=(AxisType.Explicit, AxisType.Explicit))
    sampler_dtype = jnp.dtype(cfg.dtypes.sampler)
    quantized = sampler_dtype.itemsize == 1
    float_dtype = jnp.bfloat16 if quantized else sampler_dtype
    copy_to_sampler = jax.jit(
        lambda weights: {k: w.astype(float_dtype) if w.ndim > 1 and "norm" not in k else w for k, w in weights.items()},
        out_shardings={k: NamedSharding(sampler_mesh, w.sharding.spec) for k, w in model.weights.items()})
    scale = cfg.sampler.weight_noise_scale
    noise = copy_to_sampler(fixed_weight_delta(model.weights, jax.random.fold_in(key, 2), scale)) if scale else None

    @partial(jax.jit, donate_argnums=() if quantized else (0,))
    def perturb_and_quantize(weights, noise):
        if noise is not None:
            weights = jax.tree.map(jnp.add, weights, noise)
        return quant.quantize_tree(weights, sampler_dtype) if quantized else weights

    def sampler_snapshot(weights):
        weights = copy_to_sampler(jax.block_until_ready(weights))
        with jax.set_mesh(sampler_mesh):
            return perturb_and_quantize(weights, noise)

    sampler_forward = partial(model.forward, dtype=float_dtype, kv_quant_bits=cfg.sampler.kv_quant_bits)
    sampler_init_kv = partial(model.init_kv, dtype=float_dtype)
    # Eval samples in clean bf16: it measures the policy, not the sampler.
    eval_forward = partial(model.forward, dtype=jnp.bfloat16)

    env = rollout.load_env(cfg.env.id, **(OmegaConf.to_container(cfg.env.args) if cfg.env.args else {}))
    # Hub datasets are ordered by source: shuffle so they aren't a curriculum.
    dataset = env.get_dataset().shuffle(seed=cfg.run.seed)
    eval_rows = [dataset[i] for i in range(cfg.eval.num_prompts)]  # held out from training
    dataset = dataset.select(range(cfg.eval.num_prompts, len(dataset)))
    num_prompts, group_size, seq_len = cfg.rl.num_prompts, cfg.rl.group_size, cfg.rl.seq_len
    assert cfg.eval.num_prompts % num_prompts == 0, "eval.num_prompts must be a multiple of rl.num_prompts"
    token_sharding = NamedSharding(trainer_mesh, P("data", None))
    head_sharding = NamedSharding(trainer_mesh, P("data", None, None))

    def sample(rows, weights, key, forward, vocab_logprobs=None):
        """group_size scored completions per row. Returns the trainer-side batch,
        the full sampler logprobs if requested (still on the sampler mesh), the
        rewards, and rollout statistics."""
        rows = [{**row, "example_id": i} for i, row in enumerate(rows) for _ in range(group_size)]
        tokens, prompt_lengths = rollout.prompt_buffer(rows, model.tokenizer, seq_len, cfg.env.prompt_format)
        with jax.set_mesh(sampler_mesh):
            tokens, token_logprobs, vocab, head_logprobs, head_ids = sampling.generate(
                key, model, weights, forward, sampler_init_kv, tokens, prompt_lengths,
                logprobs_dtype=jnp.float32 if vocab_logprobs == "full" else None,
                logprobs_topk=vocab_logprobs if isinstance(vocab_logprobs, int) else 0)
            host_tokens = np.asarray(tokens)
        mask, lengths, texts = rollout.completions(host_tokens, prompt_lengths, model.tokenizer)
        batch = {"tokens": reshard(tokens, token_sharding), "mask": jax.device_put(mask, token_sharding),
                 "sampling_token_logprobs": reshard(token_logprobs, token_sharding)}
        if head_ids is not None:
            batch |= {"sampler_topk_ids": reshard(head_ids, head_sharding),
                      "sampler_topk_logprobs": reshard(head_logprobs, head_sharding)}
        truncated = (prompt_lengths + lengths >= seq_len) & (host_tokens[:, -1] != model.tokenizer.eos_token_id)
        stats = {"mean_completion_len": lengths.mean(), "frac_truncated": truncated.mean()}
        return batch, vocab, rollout.score(env.rubric, rows, texts, group_size), stats

    eval_key = jax.random.fold_in(key, 3)  # the same eval prompts and key every time

    def evaluate():
        weights = copy_to_sampler(jax.block_until_ready(model.weights))
        return np.mean([
            sample(eval_rows[i:i + num_prompts], weights, jax.random.fold_in(eval_key, i), eval_forward)[2]
            for i in range(0, len(eval_rows), num_prompts)])

    @partial(jax.jit, donate_argnums=(0, 1))
    def optimize(weights, opt_state, batch):
        def objective(weights):
            # padding is dead weight in the MoE dispatch: mask it out
            hidden = model.forward(batch["tokens"], weights, dtype=jnp.bfloat16, logits=False,
                                   live=batch["tokens"] != model.tokenizer.pad_token_id)
            head = lambda x: model.head(x, weights, dtype=jnp.bfloat16)
            return losses.loss_fn_rl(hidden, head, batch, correction)

        (loss, metrics), grads = jax.value_and_grad(objective, has_aux=True)(weights)
        updates, opt_state = optimizer.update(grads, opt_state, weights)
        weights = optax.apply_updates(weights, updates)
        return weights, opt_state, {"loss": loss, "grad_norm": optax.global_norm(grads), **metrics}

    peak_reward = collapse_steps = 0
    for step in tqdm(range(cfg.stop.steps), disable=jax.process_index() != 0):
        if step % (cfg.sampler.staleness + 1) == 0:
            sampler_weights = sampler_snapshot(model.weights)
        metrics = {}
        if eval_rows and (step % cfg.eval.every_steps == 0 or step == cfg.stop.steps - 1):
            metrics["eval_reward"] = evaluate()

        rows = [dataset[(step * num_prompts + i) % len(dataset)] for i in range(num_prompts)]
        key, sample_key = jax.random.split(key)
        batch, vocab, rewards, stats = sample(
            rows, sampler_weights, sample_key, sampler_forward, cfg.sampler.vocab_logprobs)
        advantages = losses.compute_advantages(rewards, group_size, cfg.rl.reward_mode)
        batch["advantages"] = jax.device_put(advantages, NamedSharding(trainer_mesh, P("data")))
        if cfg.sampler.staleness == 0:
            del sampler_weights
        if vocab is not None:
            # Reshard only once the sampler weights are freed: source, destination
            # and collective scratch of this [B, T, V] array set the memory peak.
            batch["sampling_vocab_logprobs"] = reshard(vocab, NamedSharding(trainer_mesh, P("data", None, "model")))
            del vocab
        model.weights, opt_state, opt_metrics = optimize(model.weights, opt_state, batch)
        del batch

        reward = rewards.mean()
        peak_reward = max(peak_reward, reward)
        collapse_steps = collapse_steps + 1 if reward < cfg.stop.collapse * peak_reward else 0
        utils.log_metrics(step, {"reward": reward, "frac_nonzero_advantage": (advantages != 0).mean(),
                                 **stats, **opt_metrics, **metrics}, run_dir)
        if collapse_steps == 10:
            print(f"reward collapsed below {cfg.stop.collapse} x peak: stopping")
            break

    if cfg.log.save_model and jax.process_index() == 0:
        models.save(model, run_dir / "final_model")
    if jax.process_index() == 0:
        wandb.finish()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Spawn, never fork: forked scorer workers would inherit this threaded CUDA process.
    import multiprocessing

"""CPU-sized version of the RL setup in train_rl.py.

A tiny causal transformer learns, by RL, to sort a short list of digits. The
rollouts come from a sampler whose weights are the trainer's plus a fixed
relative Gaussian perturbation (as `sampler.weight_noise_scale` in
train_rl.py), refreshed from the trainer every step. The loss is
./losses.py's loss_fn_rl, called with the same batch layout as train_rl.py,
so any loss written for train_rl.py runs here unchanged.

    python dev/mini.py [key=value ...]     (or ./run_dev.sh without a GPU)
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from functools import partial
from pathlib import Path

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np
import optax

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- task
DIGITS = 10
SEP, EOS = DIGITS, DIGITS + 1
# Extra tokens that never appear in a correct answer, as the many unlikely
# tokens of an LLM vocabulary (env MINI_EXTRA_TOKENS).
EXTRA = int(os.environ.get("MINI_EXTRA_TOKENS", "0"))
VOCAB = DIGITS + 2 + EXTRA
PROMPT = int(os.environ.get("MINI_PROMPT", "5"))  # digits to sort
T = PROMPT + 1 + PROMPT + 1     # prompt, SEP, answer, EOS


def make_prompts(key, n):
    digits = jax.random.randint(key, (n, PROMPT), 0, DIGITS)
    return jnp.concatenate([digits, jnp.full((n, 1), SEP)], 1)


def rewards(tokens):
    """Fraction of answer positions that match the sorted prompt, 0 unless
    the answer is followed by EOS. In [0, 1]."""
    target = jnp.sort(tokens[:, :PROMPT], 1)
    answer = tokens[:, PROMPT + 1:PROMPT + 1 + PROMPT]
    ok_end = tokens[:, -1] == EOS
    return (answer == target).mean(1) * ok_end


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- model
def init_params(key, d=64, layers=2, heads=4):
    ks = iter(jax.random.split(key, 4 + 6 * layers))
    n = lambda shape, s: s * jax.random.normal(next(ks), shape)
    p = {"embed": n((VOCAB, d), 0.5), "pos": n((T, d), 0.5), "out": n((d, VOCAB), d ** -0.5)}
    for i in range(layers):
        p[f"l{i}.qkv"] = n((d, 3 * d), d ** -0.5)
        p[f"l{i}.o"] = n((d, d), d ** -0.5)
        p[f"l{i}.up"] = n((d, 4 * d), d ** -0.5)
        p[f"l{i}.down"] = n((4 * d, d), (4 * d) ** -0.5)
        p[f"l{i}.ln1"] = jnp.ones(d)
        p[f"l{i}.ln2"] = jnp.ones(d)
    p["lnf"] = jnp.ones(d)
    return p


def rms(x, g):
    return x * jax.lax.rsqrt((x * x).mean(-1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6) * g


def forward(p, tokens, heads=4):
    """Pre-head hidden states [B, T, d]."""
    x = p["embed"][tokens] + p["pos"][: tokens.shape[1]]
    B, L, d = x.shape
    causal = jnp.tril(jnp.ones((L, L), bool))
    layers = sum(1 for k in p if k.endswith(".qkv"))
    for i in range(layers):
        h = rms(x, p[f"l{i}.ln1"]) @ p[f"l{i}.qkv"]
        q, k, v = (a.reshape(B, L, heads, d // heads) for a in jnp.split(h, 3, -1))
        att = jnp.einsum("bqhd,bkhd->bhqk", q, k) / (d // heads) ** 0.5
        att = jax.nn.softmax(jnp.where(causal, att, -1e9), -1)
        x = x + jnp.einsum("bhqk,bkhd->bqhd", att, v).reshape(B, L, d) @ p[f"l{i}.o"]
        x = x + jax.nn.gelu(rms(x, p[f"l{i}.ln2"]) @ p[f"l{i}.up"]) @ p[f"l{i}.down"]
    return rms(x, p["lnf"])


def head(p, x):
    return x @ p["out"]


def logprobs(p, tokens):
    return jax.nn.log_softmax(head(p, forward(p, tokens)).astype(jnp.float32))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- sampling
@partial(jax.jit, static_argnames=("topk",))
def generate(key, p, prompts, topk=0):
    """Fill tokens after the prompt by sampling. Returns tokens [B, T], the
    sampled tokens' logprobs and the full next-token logprobs, aligned like
    train_rl.py: position t holds the distribution of token t+1."""
    B = prompts.shape[0]
    tokens = jnp.concatenate([prompts, jnp.zeros((B, T - prompts.shape[1]), prompts.dtype)], 1)
    vocab_lp = jnp.zeros((B, T, VOCAB))
    for t in range(prompts.shape[1] - 1, T - 1):
        lp = logprobs(p, tokens)[:, t]
        key, k = jax.random.split(key)
        tok = jax.random.categorical(k, lp)
        tokens = tokens.at[:, t + 1].set(tok)
        vocab_lp = vocab_lp.at[:, t].set(lp)
    targets = jnp.roll(tokens, -1, 1)
    tok_lp = jnp.take_along_axis(vocab_lp, targets[..., None], -1)[..., 0]
    return tokens, tok_lp, vocab_lp


def completion_mask(B):
    m = np.zeros((B, T), bool)
    m[:, PROMPT + 1:] = True
    return jnp.asarray(m)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- SFT warm start
def warm_start(key, steps=300, batch=128, lr=3e-3):
    """Supervised start, stopped early so RL has room: like a pretrained LLM."""
    p = init_params(key)
    opt = optax.adam(lr)
    state = opt.init(p)

    @jax.jit
    def step(p, state, key):
        prompts = make_prompts(key, batch)
        tokens = jnp.concatenate([prompts, jnp.sort(prompts[:, :PROMPT], 1), jnp.full((batch, 1), EOS)], 1)
        mask = completion_mask(batch)

        def loss(p):
            lp = logprobs(p, tokens)
            tok = jnp.take_along_axis(lp, jnp.roll(tokens, -1, 1)[..., None], -1)[..., 0]
            m = jnp.roll(mask, -1, 1).at[:, -1].set(False)
            return -(tok * m).sum() / m.sum()

        l, g = jax.value_and_grad(loss)(p)
        u, state = opt.update(g, state, p)
        return optax.apply_updates(p, u), state, l

    for i in range(steps):
        key, k = jax.random.split(key)
        p, state, l = step(p, state, k)
    return p


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- RL
METHODS = {
    # name: (ISCorrection kwargs or None, unused)
    "pg": (None, False),
    "tis": (dict(high=2.0, outside="clamp"), False),
    "mis": (dict(low=0.5, high=5.0), False),
}


def load_losses(path):
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mini_losses", path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def train(method="pg", noise=0.1, seed=0, steps=300, prompts_per_step=16, group=8, lr=0.05,
          warm_steps=15, losses_path=ROOT / "losses.py", log_every=10, loss_fn=None, verbose=False,
          reward_mode="group_centered", vocab_logprobs=None, correction=None):
    """method: a key of METHODS (reference losses.py with that correction) or
    "submission": losses_path's loss_fn_rl(hidden, head, batch, correction),
    with correction built from the rl.is.* dict `correction` (or None).
    vocab_logprobs: what the sampler records for the loss, as in train_rl.py:
    None (sampled tokens only), "full", or an int k (top-k head under the
    starter's names sampler_topk_ids / sampler_topk_logprobs)."""
    losses = load_losses(losses_path)
    key = jax.random.key(seed)
    k_warm, k_noise, key = jax.random.split(key, 3)
    params = warm_start(k_warm, warm_steps)
    delta = jax.tree.map(lambda w, k: noise * jax.random.normal(k, w.shape) * w, params,
                         jax.tree.unflatten(jax.tree.structure(params),
                                            list(jax.random.split(k_noise, len(jax.tree.leaves(params))))))
    if loss_fn is None and method == "submission":
        corr = losses.ISCorrection(**correction).check() if correction else None
        loss_fn = lambda h, hd, b: losses.loss_fn_rl(h, hd, b, corr)
    elif loss_fn is None:
        cfg, _ = METHODS[method]
        corr = losses.ISCorrection(**cfg).check() if cfg else None
        loss_fn = lambda h, hd, b: losses.loss_fn_rl(h, hd, b, corr)
    opt = optax.sgd(lr)
    state = opt.init(params)
    B = prompts_per_step * group

    @jax.jit
    def rl_step(params, state, key):
        k_p, k_s = jax.random.split(key)
        prompts = jnp.repeat(make_prompts(k_p, prompts_per_step), group, 0)
        sampler = jax.tree.map(jnp.add, params, delta)
        tokens, tok_lp, vocab_lp = generate(k_s, sampler, prompts)
        r = rewards(tokens)
        if reward_mode == "group_centered":
            adv = r.reshape(-1, group)
            adv = (adv - adv.mean(1, keepdims=True)).reshape(-1)
        elif reward_mode == "plus_minus":
            adv = 2 * r - 1
        else:
            raise ValueError(reward_mode)
        mask = completion_mask(B)
        batch = {"tokens": tokens, "mask": mask, "advantages": adv, "sampling_token_logprobs": tok_lp}
        if vocab_logprobs == "full":
            batch["sampling_vocab_logprobs"] = vocab_lp
        elif isinstance(vocab_logprobs, int):
            top_lp, top_ids = jax.lax.top_k(vocab_lp, min(vocab_logprobs, VOCAB))
            batch |= {"sampler_topk_ids": top_ids, "sampler_topk_logprobs": top_lp}

        def objective(params):
            return loss_fn(forward(params, tokens), lambda x: head(params, x), batch)

        (loss, metrics), grads = jax.value_and_grad(objective, has_aux=True)(params)
        updates, state = opt.update(grads, state, params)
        params = optax.apply_updates(params, updates)
        clean_lp = jnp.take_along_axis(logprobs(params, tokens), jnp.roll(tokens, -1, 1)[..., None], -1)[..., 0]
        m = jnp.roll(mask, -1, 1).at[:, -1].set(False)
        kl = ((tok_lp - clean_lp) * m).sum() / m.sum()
        tail_q = (jnp.exp(vocab_lp[..., DIGITS + 2:]).sum(-1) * m).sum() / m.sum()
        return params, state, {"reward": r.mean(), "kl_samp_train": kl, "grad_norm": optax.global_norm(grads),
                               "tail_mass_q": tail_q}

    @jax.jit
    def evaluate(params, key):
        tokens, _, _ = generate(key, params, make_prompts(jax.random.key(123), 512))
        return rewards(tokens).mean()

    log = []
    for step in range(steps):
        key, k = jax.random.split(key)
        params, state, m = rl_step(params, state, k)
        row = {"step": step, **{k: float(v) for k, v in m.items()}}
        if step % log_every == 0 or step == steps - 1:
            row["eval_reward"] = float(evaluate(params, jax.random.key(7)))
            if verbose:
                print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
        log.append(row)
    return log


# Default setting (the evaluation uses other seeds).
SETTING = dict(noise=0.3, steps=600, lr=0.2, reward_mode="plus_minus")


def parse_config(args):
    """key=value overrides as in train_rl.py: sampler.vocab_logprobs
    (null | full | k) and rl.is.* (an ISCorrection). Others are ignored."""
    vocab, correction = None, {}
    for arg in args:
        key, _, value = arg.partition("=")
        if key == "sampler.vocab_logprobs":
            vocab = None if value in ("null", "None", "") else value if value == "full" else int(value)
        elif key.startswith("rl.is."):
            field = key[len("rl.is."):]
            if field == "level" and value in ("null", "None"):
                correction = None
                continue
            if correction is None:
                correction = {}
            correction[field] = float(value) if field in ("low", "high") else value
    if correction and "level" not in correction:
        correction["level"] = "token"
    return vocab, (correction or None)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Train with ./losses.py on the CPU setting; key=value overrides.")
    ap.add_argument("--method", default="submission", choices=[*METHODS, "submission"])
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=SETTING["steps"])
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, help="write metrics as JSON lines here")
    args, overrides = ap.parse_known_args()
    vocab, correction = parse_config(overrides)
    t0 = time.time()
    setting = {**SETTING, "steps": args.steps}
    log = train(args.method, seed=args.seed, log_every=25, verbose=args.out is None,

    if args.out:

        args.out.write_text("".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in log))
    print(f"done in {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", file=sys.stderr)

"""Single-turn rollouts with verifiers environments: prompts in, rewards out."""
import asyncio
import importlib

import numpy as np
import verifiers as vf

LOCAL_ENVS = {"countdown": "envs.countdown", "intellect-math": "envs.intellect_math"}


def load_env(env_id, **args):
    """Local environments by name; anything else from the verifiers hub."""
    if env_id in LOCAL_ENVS:
        return importlib.import_module(LOCAL_ENVS[env_id]).load_environment(**args)
    return vf.load_environment(env_id, **args)


def tokenize_prompt(messages, tokenizer, prompt_format):
    """chat: the chat template plus generation prompt (post-trained models).
    text: the message contents as a plain continuation (Base models)."""
    if prompt_format == "chat":
        return tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            messages, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=True, return_dict=False, enable_thinking=False)
    assert prompt_format == "text", prompt_format
    text = "\n\n".join(message["content"] for message in messages)
    return tokenizer.encode(text if text.endswith("\n") else text + "\n", add_special_tokens=False)


def prompt_buffer(rows, tokenizer, seq_len, prompt_format):
    """[rows, seq_len] token buffer holding each prompt, padded on the right."""
    tokens = np.full((len(rows), seq_len), tokenizer.pad_token_id, np.int32)
    prompt_lengths = np.zeros(len(rows), np.int32)
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        prompt = tokenize_prompt(row["prompt"], tokenizer, prompt_format)[:seq_len]
        tokens[i, :len(prompt)] = prompt
        prompt_lengths[i] = len(prompt)
    return tokens, prompt_lengths


def completions(tokens, prompt_lengths, tokenizer):
    """Loss mask over each completion (including its EOS), lengths, and texts."""
    mask = np.zeros(tokens.shape, bool)
    lengths = np.zeros(len(tokens), np.int32)
    texts = []
    for i, prompt_length in enumerate(prompt_lengths):
        generated = tokens[i, prompt_length:]
        stop = np.isin(generated, [tokenizer.eos_token_id, tokenizer.pad_token_id])
        end = int(stop.argmax()) if stop.any() else len(generated)
        lengths[i] = end + (end < len(generated) and generated[end] == tokenizer.eos_token_id)
        mask[i, prompt_length:prompt_length + lengths[i]] = True
        texts.append(tokenizer.decode(generated[:end], skip_special_tokens=True))
    return mask, lengths, texts


def score(rubric, rows, texts, group_size):
    states = [vf.State(input=row, prompt=row["prompt"], trajectory=[], completion=[vf.AssistantMessage(content=text)],
                       answer=row.get("answer", ""), info=row.get("info", {}))
              for row, text in zip(rows, texts)]

    async def score_all():
        if rubric.has_group_rewards:
            for start in range(0, len(states), group_size):
                await rubric.score_group(states[start:start + group_size])
        else:
            await asyncio.gather(*(rubric.score_rollout(state) for state in states))
        await asyncio.gather(*(rubric.cleanup(state) for state in states))

    asyncio.run(score_all())
    return np.asarray([state.get("reward") or 0.0 for state in states], np.float32)

"""Fixed-batch autoregressive sampling with a KV cache."""
from functools import partial
from typing import NamedTuple

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax.sharding import PartitionSpec as P, reshard

from models import topk


class SamplingState(NamedTuple):
    position: int
    key: jax.Array
    tokens: jax.Array
    kv: list
    done: jax.Array
    token_logprobs: jax.Array
    vocab_logprobs: jax.Array | None
    head: topk.Carry | None


def _step(state, forward, weights, prompt_lengths, eos_id):
    key, sample_key = jax.random.split(state.key)
    positions = reshard(jnp.full((state.tokens.shape[0], 1), state.position), P("data", None))
    # Finished slots decode padding: mask them out of the MoE dispatch so they cost no expert flops or gather traffic.
    logits, kv = forward(state.tokens[:, state.position, None], weights, state.kv, positions, live=~state.done[:, None])
    logits = logits[:, 0].astype(jnp.float32)
    logprobs = jax.nn.log_softmax(logits)
    sampled = jax.random.categorical(sample_key, logits)
    vocab_logprobs = state.vocab_logprobs
    if vocab_logprobs is not None:
        vocab_logprobs = vocab_logprobs.at[:, state.position].set(logprobs.astype(vocab_logprobs.dtype))
    head = state.head
    if head is not None:
        head = topk.observe(head, state.position, logprobs)

    buffered_token = state.tokens[:, state.position + 1]
    sampling = (~state.done) & (state.position + 1 >= prompt_lengths)
    next_token = jnp.where(sampling, sampled, buffered_token)
    tokens = state.tokens.at[:, state.position + 1].set(next_token)
    targets = reshard(jax.nn.one_hot(next_token, logits.shape[-1], dtype=jnp.float32),
                      jax.typeof(logprobs).sharding.spec)
    token_logprobs = state.token_logprobs.at[:, state.position].set(
        jnp.where(state.done, 0.0, (targets * logprobs).sum(-1)))
    done = state.done | (sampling & (sampled == eos_id))
    return SamplingState(state.position + 1, key, tokens, kv, done, token_logprobs, vocab_logprobs, head)


@partial(jax.jit, static_argnames=("forward", "init_kv", "vocab_size", "logprobs_dtype", "logprobs_topk"))
def _generate(key, forward, init_kv, weights, tokens, prompt_lengths,
              eos_id, vocab_size, logprobs_dtype, logprobs_topk):
    batch_size, seq_len = tokens.shape
    state = SamplingState(
        position=0, key=key, tokens=reshard(tokens, P("data", None)), kv=init_kv(batch_size, seq_len),
        done=jnp.zeros(batch_size, bool, out_sharding=P("data")),
        token_logprobs=jnp.zeros((batch_size, seq_len), jnp.float32, out_sharding=P("data", None)),
        vocab_logprobs=None if logprobs_dtype is None else jnp.zeros(
            (batch_size, seq_len, vocab_size), logprobs_dtype, out_sharding=P("data", None, "model")),
        head=topk.init(batch_size, seq_len, vocab_size, logprobs_topk) if logprobs_topk else None)
    state = jax.lax.while_loop(lambda state: (state.position + 1 < seq_len) & (~state.done).any(),
                               lambda state: _step(state, forward, weights, prompt_lengths, eos_id), state)
    head_logprobs, head_ids = topk.finalize(state.head, state.position, seq_len) if logprobs_topk else (None, None)
    return state.tokens, state.token_logprobs, state.vocab_logprobs, head_logprobs, head_ids


def generate(key, model, weights, forward, init_kv, tokens, prompt_lengths, logprobs_dtype=None, logprobs_topk=0):
    """Fill a fixed token batch after each row's prompt and record the sampling
    distribution: per-token logprobs always, plus either the full [B, T, V]
    logprobs (logprobs_dtype) or the per-step top-k head (logprobs_topk), at
    ~k/V the memory."""
    prompt_lengths = reshard(jnp.asarray(prompt_lengths, jnp.int32), P("data"))
    return _generate(reshard(key, P()), forward, init_kv, weights, tokens, prompt_lengths,
                     model.tokenizer.eos_token_id, model.config["vocab_size"], logprobs_dtype, logprobs_topk)

"""Exact distributed top-k collection of per-step sampling distributions.

Records every decode step's exact top-k head without materializing the full
[batch, seq, vocab] history. Steps accumulate in a [batch, CHUNK, vocab] ring
buffer, then one batched selection per chunk compresses them into the head
buffers. Total ring memory is CHUNK/seq of the full array.

Each vocabulary shard selects its exact local top-k; a second exact top-k over
the concatenated shard candidates gives the exact global result. The
transported payload remains [batch, seq, k].

Carry-based API for jitted decode loops:

    carry = init(batch_size, seq_len, vocab_size, k)
    carry = observe(carry, position, logprobs)     # every step
    head_logprobs, head_ids = finalize(carry, position, seq_len)
"""
from typing import NamedTuple

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

    head_logprobs: jax.Array
    head_ids: jax.Array

    padded = -(-seq_len // CHUNK) * CHUNK

"""Summarize a training run from its logs.jsonl: a table of the main
metrics every few steps, a text plot of the training reward, and a verdict
on whether the reward collapsed."""
import json
import sys

COLUMNS = ("reward", "eval_reward", "kl_samp_train", "grad_norm", "pol_entropy")
BLOCKS = " ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█"


def load(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]


def sparkline(values, width=60):
    if not values:
        return ""
    step = max(1, len(values) // width)
    pts = [sum(values[i:i + step]) / len(values[i:i + step]) for i in range(0, len(values), step)]
    lo, hi = min(pts), max(pts)
    span = hi - lo or 1.0
    return "".join(BLOCKS[round((v - lo) / span * (len(BLOCKS) - 1))] for v in pts) + f"  [{lo:.3f} .. {hi:.3f}]"


def fmt(value):
    return f"{value:>12.4g}" if isinstance(value, (int, float)) else f"{'':>12}"


def summarize(rows, every=10):
    print(f"{'step':>6}" + "".join(f"{c:>12}" for c in COLUMNS))
    for row in rows:
        if row["step"] % every == 0 or "eval_reward" in row or row is rows[-1]:
            print(f"{row['step']:>6}" + "".join(fmt(row.get(c)) for c in COLUMNS))
    rewards = [r["reward"] for r in rows if "reward" in r]
    print("\nreward " + sparkline(rewards))
    evals = [(r["step"], r["eval_reward"]) for r in rows if "eval_reward" in r]
    peak = max(rewards, default=0.0)
    final = sum(rewards[-10:]) / max(len(rewards[-10:]), 1)
    print(f"\nsteps run: {len(rows)}   peak reward: {peak:.3f}   mean of last 10: {final:.3f}")
    if evals:
        print("eval reward: " + ", ".join(f"step {s}: {v:.3f}" for s, v in evals))
    collapsed = peak > 0 and final < 0.5 * peak
    print("verdict: COLLAPSED (last 10 below half the peak)" if collapsed else "verdict: no collapse")
    return collapsed


if __name__ == "__main__":
    rows = load(sys.argv[1])
    if not rows:
        sys.exit("no metrics logged")
    summarize(rows)

cat > /workspace/REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# Sampler-expected score centering for REINFORCE under sampler mismatch

## What is wrong with the current loss

`loss_fn_rl` differentiates `w * log p_theta(y_t | h_t) * A` at every completion
token, where `y_t ~ q(. | h_t)` is the token the sampler drew, `A` is the
sequence advantage, and `w` is an optional detached IS weight. Fix a prefix
`h` and write `p_v = p_theta(v|h)`, `q_v = q(v|h)`, `s_v = grad_theta log p_v`,
`A_v = E[A | h, y = v]`, `Abar_q = sum_v q_v A_v`. With no correction, the
expected update at this position is

    E_q[A s_y | h] = sum_v q_v A_v s_v
                   = Abar_q * sbar_q(h) + Cov_q(A, s_y | h),
    sbar_q(h) = sum_v q_v s_v = grad_theta sum_v q_v log p_v.

On-policy (q = p) the first term vanishes because
`sum_v p_v s_v = grad_theta sum_v p_v = 0`. Under mismatch it does not: since
`sum_v p_v s_v = 0`, we have `sbar_q = sum_v (q_v - p_v) s_v`, which is first
order in the mismatch `q - p`. The term `Abar_q * sbar_q(h)` is the drift of
the hint. Its coefficient is the expected advantage at the prefix, which is
generically nonzero (good prefixes, bad prefixes), while the direction
`sbar_q(h)` is not a reward direction. It is the gradient of `sum_v q_v log p_v`,
which raises the trainer's log-probability of whatever the sampler
over-represents and lowers that of what it under-represents. Under a fixed
sampler this direction is systematic, so it does not average out over the
batch or over steps. Because the sampler is refreshed from the trainer at
every step, the same mismatch is re-injected at every step, and the bias
accumulates in the parameters. That is the observed degradation.

Why the existing knobs only slow it down. A per-token IS weight `w_v = p_v/q_v`
on the sampled token would give `E_q[w A s_y] = sum_v p_v A_v s_v`, which is the
on-policy expectation and has no drift. It is exact only where the weight is
not truncated. Clipping or dropping `w` (TIS, PPO, DAPO, ...) changes the
coefficient of each `s_v` to `q_v * clip(p_v/q_v) * A_v`, which again leaves
`sum_v c_v A_v s_v` with `c_v` not equal to `p_v`, so a drift term of the same

Loss uses log p(y|h) - sum_v q(v|h) log p(v|h) (q stop-gradient), so the expected update under q becomes sum_v q_v (A_v - Abar_q) s_v = Cov_q(A, s_y|h), removing the drift Abar_q * sbar_q exactly. On-policy the subtracted term has zero mean, so the estimator is unchanged in expectation. The loss needs the sampler's distribution: it uses sampling_vocab_logprobs (full) or sampler_topk_ids/logprobs (top-k, renormalized). If absent, it falls back to plain REINFORCE. Added sampler_keys for the vocab keys.

Configuration (in REPORT.md): sampler.vocab_logprobs=32. Full vocab is infeasible at Qwen vocab size.

Checks on dev/mini.py (CPU): plain REINFORCE collapses to 0 in all mismatch settings tried (noise 0.6; noise 0.3 with lr 0.6; noise 0.3 with 200 extra tokens; noise 0.6 with extra tokens). Centered loss stays stable (about 0.5 to 0.8 eval) with full vocab and with top-32. Top-8 is stable but lower. On-policy (noise 0) matches plain REINFORCE. ./run_dev.sh with sampler.vocab_logprobs=32 runs without error. The mini setup and the real Qwen run were not tested on GPU.
